page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c1.large is a compute-optimized virtual machine instance based on the KVM hypervisor and the x86_64 CPU architecture. It features 8 dedicated physical CPU cores with 1 thread per core, resulting in 8 vCPUs. The instance is configured with 16.0 GB of system memory, providing a memory-to-core ratio of 2.0 GB per core.

This instance does not include any local storage, meaning all storage must be attached externally. It also lacks dedicated GPU hardware, with a GPU count of 0.0, and does not include any complimentary public IPv4 addresses. These specifications represent a trade-off, prioritizing dedicated CPU allocation over local storage capacity and accelerated graphics processing.

The dedicated CPU allocation and 1:2 CPU-to-RAM ratio make the ecs.c1.large suitable for compute-bound workloads that require consistent CPU performance without the overhead of hyperthreading. Appropriate workloads include web serving, batch processing, and lightweight computational tasks that do not require massive memory footprints or local storage.
